items.title: Tech investors are looking at AI with 'more nuance' as it fuels software demand
items.summary: Salesforce stock (CRM) surges ahead by over 22% on Thursday since releasing strong second quarter earnings results, coming at a time when AI demand is driving growth within the software sector. Macquarie US head of software and services research Steve Koenig examines what he is seeing from tech investors and how Salesforce performed.

items.title: AI Winner or Victim? Inside Salesforce's Q2 earnings
items.summary: RBC Capital Markets managing director Rishi Jaluria joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to assess Salesforce's (CRM) latest earnings reporting, which shows profits beating expectations. Jaluria highlights how Salesforce is addressing AI's impact on the software industry and the effectiveness of its latest acquisitions.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise With Fed Chief Warsh Due; Nvidia, These 7 Stocks Are In Buy Zones
items.summary: Nvidia broke out on earnings but didn't have coattails. Meanwhile several software stocks flashed buy signals on a trio of earnings. Fed chief Kevin Warsh's big speech looms.

items.title: Salesforce (CRM) Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of CRM software giant Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) jumped 18.9% in the afternoon session after the company reported second-quarter financial results that exceeded expectations and raised its full-year earnings guidance, buoyed by rapid growth in its artificial intelligence business.

items.title: Salesforce Stock Just Soared. Thank Anthropic.
items.summary: Adjusted earnings per share doubled. And investors have less reason to believe AI will hurt Salesforce's business. Anthropic is driving both of these.

items.title: CRM Q2 Deep Dive: AI-Powered Product Momentum and Flexible Pricing Drive Outperformance
items.summary: CRM software giant Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.8% year on year to $11.35 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $11.46 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.90 per share was 80.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
